small_guidance:
- The correctness bug is in the K-loop: `offs_k = tl.arange(0, K)` uses K_padded (128) but the actual K is 81. The mask `offs_k < K` compares against K_padded, not the true K=81, so weights and `kw_i/kh_i/kd_i/ic_i` decompositions index out-of-range and produce garbage. Pass `K_TRUE` (=IC*KD*KH*KW=81) as a separate constexpr and mask with `offs_k < K_TRUE`; also clamp the decomposed indices when masked so x_offsets stay in-bounds.
- Tighten the spatial gather: precompute `oh*W+ow` (per n) and `kh_i*W+kw_i` (per k) once, then sum to form `h_pos*W+w_pos` — saves a multiply per (k,n) inside the OD loop.
- Add autotune configs with `BLOCK_M=24` (exact OC) and `BLOCK_N∈{100, 128}` (OH*OW=900) along with `num_stages=3` to overlap the K-loop loads with the dot.
large_guidance:
- Keep the im2col-style implicit-gather GEMM-per-od with running min, but switch to channels-last input layout (N, D, H, W, IC) so the K-axis (which has IC as the slowest-varying factor in the current decomposition) becomes contiguous in memory; this makes each `tl.load` of the (K, BLOCK_N) tile coalesce. Reorder the k decomposition to `k = ((kd*KH + kh)*KW + kw)*IC + ic` to match.
- Fuse the channel-softmax epilogue into the conv-min kernel: after the OD loop produces `min_val` of shape (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N), if BLOCK_M == OC (24, pad to 32) keep the full channel vector resident and do max/exp/sum/div in-register, writing the final softmax output directly. This removes the second kernel and the round-trip through global memory.
- Alternatively, since OC=24 is tiny, restructure as one program per (N, spatial-tile) that holds all OC channels in registers across the OD loop — eliminates the OC tiling dimension entirely and makes the channel-softmax fusion trivial.
